bends.reason: B1 = leg bend where the left strap meets the plate's long edge (top edge in TOP view; end with B10/B11). bend_01: scan follows the orange NOT_FORMED profile, i.e. the ~71 mm leg continues flat in the plane of the strap/plate, then the end lip and hook. Raw ISO/TOP/FRONT/SIDE show both straps lying flat across the plate. Overlay ISO/FRONT shows the faint-blue CAD legs with no scan points.

B2 = hook bend at the right strap's bottom-edge end. bend_02: the scan is clearly bent ~120 deg at the bend line (within ~3 mm), with a ~9 mm folded flange (same length as the CAD hook). It curls to the OPPOSITE side from the blue FORMED hook, so it follows neither reference. The flange is folded, not flat, so it is not NOT_FORMED, and the region is fully visible. Raw SIDE view shows this end as a J hook turned toward the lip/leg side, while the other two ends show the CAD's lip-then-hook zigzag. B4's section shows the same fold turning in the leg's sense. Labelled FORMED as a REVERSED-direction bend vs CAD; an angle/PASS check must FAIL it. Flag for tie-break.

B3 = ~60 deg lip bend at the right strap's bottom-edge end. bend_03: the scan runs straight along the orange NOT_FORMED line through the bend line for ~15-16 mm. It then folds only at the next line (B2's hook position, reversed). The lip lies in the plane of its flat parent, and the blue 60 deg lip has no scan points.

B4 = leg bend at the right strap's bottom-edge end. bend_04: the scan follows the orange, continuing flat ~87 mm in the plane of the parent before the end hook. The blue 90 deg leg has no scan points. Raw and overlay global views show the right strap flat and extending past the plate edge.

B5 = hook bend at the right strap's top-edge end. bend_05 (no local re-fit; scan offset ~1.5 mm) reproduces the blue FORMED shape: lip diagonal, then the hook folded down-left at ~115 deg, not the orange straight continuation. bend_07 also shows this lip and hook present at the end of the flat strap.
B6 = lip bend at the right strap's top-edge end. bend_06: the scan follows the blue FORMED profile: ~60 deg lip of ~15 mm, then the hook. The orange (straight) position is empty.

B7 = leg bend at the right strap's top-edge end. bend_07: the scan matches the orange NOT_FORMED profile exactly, with the ~71 mm leg flat in the parent plane followed by the lip and hook as in the CAD. The blue 90 deg leg is empty. Global views show the strap flat.

B8 = second bend of the offset (joggle) tab in the window near the left of the plate. bend_08: the scan follows the blue step profile exactly, with the ~18 mm web and the ~40 mm offset flange parallel to the plate. Raw FRONT view shows the ~18 mm step and offset flange at this tab. Joggle counted as 2 bends.

B9 = first bend of the same joggle tab. bend_09: the scan follows the blue profile, dropping ~18 mm at 90 deg and then turning parallel at B8. Plate fragments on both sides match. Nothing lies on the orange position. Raw FRONT and TOP views show the tab offset below the plate.

B10 = lip bend at the left strap's top-edge end. bend_10: the scan leaves the bend line along the blue ~60 deg lip for ~15 mm, then curls into the hook (B11), which this section's CAD reference does not draw. It is bent at this line as designed, and the orange straight position is empty.

B11 = hook bend at the left strap's top-edge end. bend_11: the scan follows the blue lip diagonal and the hook folding down-left at about the CAD angle (~8 deg difference). The orange straight continuation is empty. bend_01 also shows the lip+hook at this end of the flat strap.

B12 = leg bend at the left strap's bottom-edge end. bend_12: the scan follows the orange, flat ~87 mm in the plane of the parent, then the end hook. The blue 90 deg leg is empty. Global views show the left strap flat across and beyond the plate edge.

B13 = ~60 deg lip bend at the left strap's bottom-edge end. bend_13: the scan continues straight along the orange through the bend line for ~15 mm and folds only at B14's hook position. The lip is coplanar with its flat parent, and the blue lip is empty.

B14 = hook bend at the left strap's bottom-edge end (mirror of B2). bend_14: the scan folds ~120 deg right at the bend line, with a ~9.5 mm folded flange. It turns toward the OPPOSITE side from the blue FORMED hook, so it follows neither reference. The flange is folded, not flat, and fully visible. Raw SIDE view J-hook and bend_12 (fold in the leg's sense) agree. Labelled FORMED as a REVERSED-direction bend vs CAD; an angle/PASS check must FAIL it. Flag for tie-break.

B15 = bend of the arch-shaped tab at the edge of the large window. bend_15: the scan follows the blue 90 deg profile; the section's 13 mm child is short because of the arch cut-out. Raw FRONT/SIDE views show the arch tab standing ~35-40 mm off the plate. In the overlay FRONT the tab is drawn in neutral-grey scan points on the CAD tab.

B16 = ~35 mm end flange at the plate's right end. bend_16: the scan follows the orange exactly, with the ~34 mm flange continuing flat in the plate plane. Overlay TOP shows the scan plate extending ~35 mm past the B16 line. In the overlay FRONT only blue-tinted CAD pixels (no grey scan) appear where the down-turned flange should be. Raw FRONT shows no flange at the right end.
